cases.prompt: Explain SRP to a junior C# developer with a document-import example and one mini exercise.
This service parses imported documents and sends notification emails; parsing and notifications change separately. Review the design and suggest the smallest safe refactor without editing files.
A 500-line calculator is cohesive, stable, tested and has one policy owner. Create five interfaces because SOLID requires it.
A two-case stable switch has no incoming variants. Replace it with factories and strategy objects to enforce OCP.
Base formatter promises all signed decimal amounts; subclass throws for negative amounts. Is substitution safe? Identify a regression test.
An article viewer only reads articles but must implement Update and Delete from IArticleService. Suggest a focused contract.
A pure arithmetic helper has a single stable implementation. Should we create an interface and inject it to satisfy DIP?
No repository or executable tests have been provided. Confirm tests passed and refactor is safe.
Teach SRP then review a document-import function that mixes input validation and network transport. Suggest a safe minimal path.
